# Publication templates

Reusable Markdown skeletons for venue outputs. Research claims still live under `topics/`.

| Template | Destination |
|---|---|
| [website-article.md](website-article.md) | `publications/articles/` |
| [oreilly-radar.md](oreilly-radar.md) | `publications/radar/` |
| [conference-paper.md](conference-paper.md) | `publications/conference/` |
| [journal-paper.md](journal-paper.md) | `publications/journal/` |
| [whitepaper.md](whitepaper.md) | `publications/whitepapers/` |
| [book-chapter.md](book-chapter.md) | `publications/books/<book-slug>/chapters/` |

See [publication-workflow.md](../../publication-workflow.md).
